description: What the macro runner is doing RIGHT NOW: whether a run is in progress, which macro the editor holds, and the freshest log lines. Unlike every other tool, this ANSWERS WHILE run_macro is still executing (extension 10.0.172+) — poll it from a second client/session to watch a long run live instead of waiting blind. screenshot is likewise answerable mid-run for a visual peek.

lines.description: How many of the latest log lines to include (1-100, default 20).

name: run_status
